sources: Official names, descriptions and grades as listed by Exophase (Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 trophies) and cross-checked against PSNProfiles; missable reporting cross-checked against PowerPyx. Guide wording is original to this entry.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own once the other 54 trophies are all earned, so treat it as the finish line of the roadmap rather than a task. If it has not popped, the tracker counts on this page show exactly which grade is still short. Sources: Exophase (official name, description and grade); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story award for finishing the named mission, Gone Fishing, as it arrives in the campaign. Play the story in order and it unlocks at the mission's end; with the spoiler setting on, this page hides its name until you earn it. Sources: Exophase (official name and description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 and this chapter trophy unlocks as the chapter closes. While you are in Chapter 1, also take the Lucia meditation moment flagged under Positive Mental Attitude, the one potentially missable stop on the whole list. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check); PowerPyx (missable note).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 of the story; the name is printed exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Chapter trophies unlock in sequence, so a gap here means an earlier chapter is unfinished. Sources: Exophase (official name and description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's missions in order and the trophy lands as the chapter ends. Keep following the roadmap's story-first order so chapter-gated content is never left behind. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4, the last of the four chapter trophies, which sets up the final mission that carries its own gold. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission; this is one of only two gold trophies on the list and it closes the story stage of the roadmap. Everything after it is strangers, collectibles, activities and cleanup on the way to 100 percent. Sources: Exophase (official description and grade); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission, Breakfast Run, when it appears in the campaign; mission trophies like this one unlock automatically at the mission's end screen. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a named story mission, and the trophy unlocks as the heist wraps up. It is separate from the free-roam bank vault robberies counted by Maximum Withdrawal. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when the campaign offers it; like the other named-mission trophies it needs no side condition beyond finishing the mission. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners to earn this one; the all-caps name is printed as PlayStation publishes it. Sources: Exophase (official name and description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a named story mission set around the airport authority; VCIA is also the place named by the secret trophy Catch Me If You Can, which is a separate free-roam act. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory; it unlocks at the end of that mission as part of the story-first stage. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach a full 100 percent on the in-game completion counter; this gold is the long pole of the platinum and it is why the roadmap leaves it to the cleanup stage, after story, strangers, collectibles and activities are done. Work the in-game completion checklist category by category and use this tracker to see which trophy families are still open. Sources: Exophase (official description and grade); PSNProfiles (cross-check); PowerPyx (roadmap context).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts in total; stunt opportunities are spread across Leonida, so bank them steadily while exploring rather than grinding them all at the end, and let the in-game counter be your tally. It is one of six silver trophies. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type at least once; breadth, not mastery, is what the description asks for. A good early sweep: one race, one drone race, one fishing challenge, one arcade game and one shooting range visit already feed several other trophies on this list. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal every Shooting Range challenge, not just finish them; if a medal is short, replay that single challenge rather than the whole set, and practise with the weapon class the challenge fixes. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win the Top Fun drone race at every location that hosts one; a second place does not count, so learn each course's line on a first run and race it again for the win. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of one favourite race do not add to the count, so move around the map and take each win once. These wins sit naturally beside Top Fun in the activities stage. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the named rival, in a fishing challenge; this is a head-to-head activity result, not the same as simply catching fish, so keep challenging him until the win registers. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game through to completion once; starting one is not enough, the description asks for a completed game. A quick, cheap trophy to bank during the activities sweep. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work Andy's strand of missions through to its final mission and finish it; character trophies like this one only land at the end of a whole strand, so if it has not popped you still have earlier missions for Andy open. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand through its final mission; strand finals are the roadmap's second stage, best done once the story has opened the map. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand at its final mission; keep each character's strand moving whenever you pass their area so no strand is left half-done for the cleanup. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight whole mission strands for strangers across Leonida; the named character finals on this list (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt) are strands of exactly this kind, so finishing those puts most of the eight in hand. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: See Randy's strand through to its final mission and complete it; one of the strand finals that together feed Strangers & Freaks. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand; if the final has not appeared, earlier missions in his strand are still outstanding. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy the sources flag as potentially missable. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida, and do not skip the Chapter 1 opportunity to meditate with Lucia: PowerPyx reports that this early spot counts toward the in-game total and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy can be earned without it, so take it when it appears and then finish the remaining spots during free roam. Keep your own tally of spots as you go — no source publishes a verified total spot count, so the in-game meditation counter, not this page, is the tally of record. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check); PowerPyx (missable flag and the Chapter 1 spot).

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting strand to the hunt for the unique animal and complete it; this is a strand task for a named character, grouped with the other character finals in the roadmap's second stage. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full sets of collectible cards; a set only counts when every card in it is found, so track which set is nearest completion and hunt its missing cards first. Card hunting pairs naturally with The Goodtime State's full-map exploration. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations; it is a coverage task like the card sets, so work district by district while exploring and let the in-game counter keep score. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges in total; challenges accumulate across the activities you are already doing for other trophies, so check the challenge list late in the run and mop up whichever short challenges remain. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise a four-star wanted level and then lose it completely; both halves matter — reach four stars first, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in one unbroken run with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between shops; pick three shops close together, move fast, and do not hide long enough for the heat to drop mid-chain. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles; variety is the point, so get in or scan vehicles you have not used before whenever you cross a new district, and it will complete well before the map is fully explored. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus; set it up where enemies cluster, line up your targets before triggering it, and do not activate it for a single straggler. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: A hidden one-off at VCIA, the airport: the description asks for an unscheduled departure there, so take an aircraft out of VCIA outside any mission script and the secret should register. It is separate from the story mission VCIA Takedown. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). Guide wording is our own reading of the official description; the exact trigger is not pinned down by the sources.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description is a joke about Rhinos, the series' tank: get into a Rhino tank and use it, and this secret is the natural result. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). Guide wording is our own reading of the official description; the sources do not pin down an exact count or place.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected; a loud entry voids the attempt, so plan a quiet approach, control the room, and leave before any alarm turns into a pursuit. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each; a vault job only counts when you get away, so plan the exit before you start the robbery, and vary vaults if one location stops counting. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck in free roam and escape the response; like Maximum Withdrawal, the escape is part of the requirement, so have a fast vehicle and a route ready before you open the truck up. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Uncover every part of the Leonida map; combine it with the card sets, WAiNK locations and meditation spots so one exploration pass feeds four trophies at once. Any grey patch left on the map is a district still to visit. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob at least one illegal operation run by each gang; robbing the same gang twice does not finish it, so note which gangs you have already hit and seek out the missing colours on the map. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A hidden leisure one-off: the description places it on Ocean Beach with a cocktail and a view, so buy or order a cocktail at Ocean Beach and take in the view. The name is printed with the ellipsis PlayStation publishes. Sources: Exophase (official name and description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). Guide wording is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A hidden set-piece: inside a vehicle showroom, get in a vehicle and smash your way out through the glass rather than using the door. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). Guide wording is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy placed by its description at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: go there and bowl, completing the follow-through the description jokes about. It pairs with Ten Pin, the other bowling trophy, on the same trip. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). Guide wording is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with a deliberately vague official description about a partnership; the sources checked do not pin down its exact trigger, so treat it as a story-adjacent secret that most players will meet by playing the campaign with both protagonists, and check back after major story beats. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). We claim no specific step the sources do not state.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose description points at choices made in the story; it is written as a consequence trophy rather than a task, so play the campaign and make its story choices — the sources do not name a specific decision, and we do not invent one. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A hidden retry-flavoured trophy: its description rewards a second attempt at something that failed once, so if an activity or encounter goes wrong, run it again rather than reloading — the sources do not specify which attempt, and this guide claims no more than the description supports. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A hidden oddity trophy: the description is a reaction, not an instruction, and the sources checked do not pin its trigger to a named place, so file it under exploration secrets — investigate strange encounters and oddities you find in Leonida rather than following a route we cannot cite. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock down bowling pins with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by melee, aimed at pins; the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley trip for Let's Go Bowling is the natural place to try it. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check). Guide wording is our own reading of the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Push marked bills through your laundering contacts until the laundered total reaches $250,000; only money actually laundered counts, not cash earned other ways, so keep feeding the laundering route whenever marked bills come in from robberies. Sources: Exophase (official description and amount); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops; every shop purchase counts toward the same total, so there is no need to save for one spree — outfit both protagonists as you play and it lands during the economy stage. Sources: Exophase (official description and amount); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property on sale in Leonida; garages unlock across the map as you explore, so sweep the property listings late in the run when your robbery and laundering income is at its peak. Sources: Exophase (official description); PSNProfiles (cross-check).

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; register each new vehicle you take a liking to as you discover them for Whip It Good, and the ten will accumulate without a dedicated grind. Sources: Exophase (official description and count); PSNProfiles (cross-check).
